import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.math.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        
        long best_a = 0;
        long best_b = 1;
        double min_val = Double.MAX_VALUE;
        
        for (long i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            long product = i * x;
            long rem = product % y;
            double diff = Math.min(rem, y - rem);
            double curr_val = diff / (double)i;
            
            if (curr_val < min_val) {
                min_val = curr_val;
                best_b = i;
                if (rem <= y - rem) {
                    best_a = product / y;
                } else {
                    best_a = product / y + 1;
                }
            }
        }
        
        pw.println(best_a + "/" + best_b);
        pw.close();
    }
}
